fieldValues.title: Instance
fieldValues.description: A piece of captured content, as opposed to a definition that describes a shape. An instance carries its own stable `instanceId` in an id space distinct from the `id` + namespace/name/version lineage that identifies a definition, and it is the thing Relations connect and Containers scope. Confusing the two id spaces is the most common structural error: a Container's id is not an instance id and must never appear on either end of a Relation.
fieldValues.notes: The self-declared `instanceId` inside the file is the identity. It is not derived from the filename or the path, and there is no manifest index to cross-check it against.
